title: Anisotropy in Fourier space optical memory effect correlations
summary: We investigate anisotropy in Fourier-domain speckle correlations associated with the optical memory effect in disordered scattering media. Within a single scattering framework, we show that while the conventional memory effect constrains transverse wavevector shifts, the correlation strength also depends non-trivially on differences in the axial wavevector components. Our theory is supported by numerical simulations of a three-dimensional, single scattering medium, which show excellent agreement with theory.
